headline: I can't wait to hear from you.
lead: I'm almost always refreshing my inbox, so you'll hear from me within 48 hours. But if it's a weekend, I'm out snapping wedding pics and capturing memories, so you'll hear from me at the latest by Monday.
body: No detail is too small — the more you share, the better I can tailor a proposal to fit the day you're planning.
